## Summary

Describe the isolated change and its motivation.

## Validation

- [ ] CPU tests pass
- [ ] manifest/result integrity checks pass
- [ ] shared-backbone initialization remains aligned, or the change is documented

## Experiment evidence

For result changes, link the frozen contract and report every planned seed, including failures. State the baseline, training budget, BPB delta, parameter count, and throughput method.
